description: Square 1:1. Cream ruled ledger paper with faint fibre noise; dark ink text, green ink for pass, red ink for blocked/strike-through. Archivo Black headlines and big numbers, Courier Prime typewriter body. Live asciinema shell recordings shown as panels pinned on the ledger page. Pages slide up between scenes; slow vertical drift down the page. Captions typed onto a paper tape strip at the top. Progress = row of gate checkboxes along the bottom margin. Opens on a two-number contrast hook; ends on a signed audit footer with the self-intro. Voice: Gemini TTS Orus.
